tool_signatures.name: browser_snapshot
tool_signatures.description: Read the shared page as an accessibility-style outline. Interactive elements have [ref=eN] for use with the other browser_* tools; an element keeps its ref while it stays on the page. Iframes are outlined inline, and refs inside them look like f1e3; sandboxed srcdoc frames (e.g. email viewers) are read-only, so open their links with browser_navigate. Long pages come in parts: pass the offset given at the end to read on. ${UNTRUSTED}

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long snapshot from, as given at the end of the previous part.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Character offset to continue a long snapshot from, as given at the end of the previous part.
